newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia sees little oil price change over Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia sees little oil price change over Iraq.

text.p: Indonesian Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana said on Monday he did not expect the current situation in Iraq to have an immediate effect on the oil market.
"I do not see any immediate impact on the oil market," he told Reuters.
He said he expected oil prices would "rise a little" but still remain relatively flat.
He noted that Iraq's food-for-oil deal with the United Nations still had to be implemented.
